title: AI search visibility with Notra
description: Run AI visibility scans on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and read mention rates, competitor share, content gaps, and agent readiness with Notra.

environment.name: NOTRA_API_KEY
environment.description: A Notra API key, starting with ntra_, from the API Keys page at app.usenotra.com. Give it the read and write scopes of the routes you scaffold, and keep it server-side.

environment.name: NOTRA_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Callers send this random token of at least 32 characters as Authorization: Bearer <token>, and you can generate it with openssl rand -hex 32. The function requires it because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: List projects
operations.description: Send a POST request to list your Notra projects and their ids. Every other route takes a project id.

operations.title: Start a visibility scan
operations.description: POST a projectId to ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the other tracked engines every prompt of the project. The route returns a scanId.

operations.title: Check a scan
operations.description: POST a projectId and scanId to get the scan's status and mentions per engine.

operations.title: Read visibility per engine
operations.description: POST a projectId to get mention rate, citations, and average position per AI engine. You can set days to a number from 1 to 365.

operations.title: Read competitor share
operations.description: POST a projectId to get how often each brand is mentioned in the answers. You can set days to a number from 1 to 365.

operations.title: List content gaps
operations.description: POST a projectId to list the prompts whose answers mention competitors but not you. The route also lists Search Console and AI search queries that you are missing from.

operations.title: Check agent readiness
operations.description: POST a projectId to get how well AI agents can read and use your site, or set rescan to start a new check.
